_comment: Card progression settings for the offline server (see re/notes/06-progression.md). Copied to server-data/progression.json by tools/build-server-data.py. Grades: 0=C 1=B 2=A 3=S 4=R. Difficulties: 0=easy 1=normal 2=hard.

start._why: Original: new players start with 0 cards and the tutorial gives a normal 30-card pack (tutorialNormalCardPack30). Given at save creation so there's always a leader card.

rpPerSong._why: PLACEHOLDER until fitted to real result screens. Uses the game's config constants RP_BONUS=165, RP_BONUS_REVISION=15000, RP_BONUS_EASY/NORMAL/HARD=18/45/90. rp = base + difficultyBonus * (score / revision) ^ exponent. Reference point (SuperStar JYP): maxed deck, hard, 6.37M score -> 1,541 RP; here that gives ~1,960.

packs._why: Odds per grade; secondary anchor: published drop rates of a comparable game. 'guarantee' = at least N cards of at least that grade per pack size.

firstClear._why: Original stage results have a firstClearReward card. Per song and difficulty: one card from the song's album/group, grade by difficulty, plus some RP. The RP also matters technically: the result screen hangs when a song's rewards are only card packs.

songMilestones._why: The original daily missions (mission table: play 1/4/7/20 songs -> RP, B/A/S cards, 50 diamonds), turned into repeating song-count milestones.

recordLadder._why: Original monthly 'My Record' ladder (myrecord table, last month's tiers), run once: counts distinct songs cleared.

gradeUp._why: Two cards of the same member and grade, both at max level, become one card of the next grade (same member, level 1). Cost not in the tables; RP = sell price of the two cards.
